title: Comparison of chosen-product and categorical etale Cech complexes
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme and let $X_{\mathrm{Et}}$ be its small etale category [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Let $U$ be an object, let $T$ be a set, and let $f_t:V_t\to U$ be any indexed family. Let $S$ specify chosen iterated fibre products, their universal properties and projection-compatible index maps as in [def-weil-pbc-site-cech-complex]. For every presheaf $F:X_{\mathrm{Et}}^{op}\to\mathrm{Ab}$, the explicit alternating restriction complex $S.\check{\mathcal C}^{\bullet}(F)$ [def-weil-pbc-site-cech-complex] is isomorphic as a cochain complex to the categorical Cech complex [def-weil-pbc-cech-complex] of the family $(V_t\to U)$ in the slice over $U$, applied to the restriction of $F$ along the forgetful functor. No covering or sheaf condition on $F$ is assumed.

proof.text: The small etale category of X has finite wide pullbacks, supplied by its Mathlib instances. Apply lem-weil-pbc-site-cech-mathlib-comparison to C = X.Etale, the given arrows f, the chosen SiteCechComplex S, and the presheaf F. Its index and coefficient universes both specialize to u+1. The resulting isomorphism is exactly the asserted one; no covering or sheaf hypothesis is required.
